title: Quiet Music Row Apt #5 • Short Ride to Downtown
description:
Song writers, artists, and visitors love this quiet apt surrounded by the rich history of Music Row..

EZ walk or cheap Uber to Downtown Nashville, neon lights of Broadway bars, Bridgestone, Ryman, Gulch, 12th S. REALLY close to Vandy, Belmont, Hillsboro Village. EZ drive or Uber to Nissan Stadium.

Relax in the courtyard or enjoy some action on the putting greens or bocce ball court.

Enjoy smart tv's, Keurig coffee, kitchen. 

FREE BAG STORAGE, PARKING, & HATCH POSTER.

Permit #2019015082

The space
A one level apartment in a one level building and with it's own front door. Hardwood floors, warm and inviting living room with love seat and accent chair. Eat-in kitchen with stove, toaster oven, microwave, coffee maker, full size fridge.

Guest access
Full roam of the apartment.

Other things to note
FREE onsite luggage storage available if you arrive early or are leaving late. Parking on the street is free plentiful between 4:00 pm and 7:30 am during the week and all day on the weekend. It's still free parking during the day but students from Belmont sometimes fill the spaces. To accommodate this, we do have off street parking behind the building to the right and directly behind this building.
